Ruling

Partial refund PARTIAL_REFUND

Refund to the rider: SGD 5.90

The judge's explanation, as written

This is a rider-filed route-deviation dispute over trip TRP-02856 (Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres to Blk 130 Bukit Batok West Ave 6). Both sides largely agree on the arithmetic, and the arithmetic decides it. A deviation is ESTABLISHED under POL-RD-01. The governing measurement is the GPS trace (gps_trace.trace_distance_km = 23.79 km), not the rounded trip-record copy of 23.8 km. Against the booked optimal of 18.3 km on EV-TRIP-02856, the excess is 5.49 km, or 30.0% of optimal. Both establishment gates pass (over 0.8 km absolute and over 20%). It does NOT reach materiality: 5.49 km is below the 8.0 km absolute gate and 30.0% is below the 50% gate. Because the deviation is not MATERIAL, the POL-RD-06 driver_profile consultation is not triggered and I accept the driver's point that no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) and no driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c) arise. The profile counters confirm this independently: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 408 completed trips in 90 days, far below the 3-flag and 0.05-rate tests. The driver's explanation (counterparty statement: 'The rider asked for IMM, it is in the chat', and the chat itself) does not reduce the excess. The rider's message MSG-02856-001 at 15:33:19 does name IMM with a platform-resolved waypoint_hint, and the driver replied 'ok', but POL-RD-04 corroboration is geographic: the trace must pass within 200 m of the waypoint. The derived waypoint approach places the nearest fix 3,088.34 m from IMM (within_threshold false), so the corroboration test fails. Under POL-RD-14 that means the instruction did not cause the measured excess: POL-RD-04 does not apply, no distance is excluded, and the deviation is measured on the trace as it stands. The driver's bare assertion of the request is an assertion that fails on the artifact it rests on. This is also not the mutually contradictory-evidence escalation in POL-RD-10(7): a request made and a route that did not follow it are consistent, and POL-RD-14 confines that trigger to the partly-corroborated case. There is no escalation on this point. No other exoneration route is open. POL-RD-03 (road closure) needs a traffic advisory: none covers this trip (EV-ADVIS-02856-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, no payload) and no party asserted a traffic cause, so no traffic excuse is even in play. POL-RD-05 does not run: pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at, amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are all null, so the baseline stays the booked 18.3 km. POL-RD-12 does not run: the vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL. POL-RD-11 does not run: the fare model is METERED, not UPFRONT_QUOTE. The refund is therefore the POL-RD-02 arithmetic on a METERED fare. The surge multiplier was read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, where it is 1.0, not assumed absent. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 18.3 + 0.28 x 24.7) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee = 24.441 + 0.80 = 25.241. Refund = charged_total 31.13 - 25.241 = 5.889, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 5.90. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis (so not NO_ACTION) and 18.9% of the charged total, far below the 90% that would convert it to a FULL_REFUND. The outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 5.90, not the SGD 8.00 contested and not the SGD 31.13 charged. Nothing is added under POL-RD-09. The fare carries no ERP lines (erp_gantries empty, tolls_erp 0.00), no airport surcharge (0.00, and the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport), and no waiting-time fee. There is no unmatched gantry and no wrongly applied surcharge, so no billing-integrity finding and no referral arises. Driver compensation under POL-RD-04 does not arise either: the rider was billed 23.8 km against a 23.79 km trace, a shortfall of well under the 1.0 km threshold. The trace is clean for POL-RD-07 purposes: 187 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, an empty gaps array and a max_gap_sec of 0.0, so no limb (a) to (c) is met and no corroboration requirement or POL-RD-10(3) escalation is engaged. Trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown (TRP-02856), timestamps do not conflict, and no charge line lacks a counterpart. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires. My confidence rests on artifacts all at weight_multiplier 1.0 (EV-GPS-02856, EV-TRIP-02856, EV-FARE-02856, EV-CHAT-02856), so the cap is 1.0; the missing advisory (weight 0.0) carries no deciding fact and does not lower it. The one rider claim citing that absent artifact was discarded at the citation stage for not naming its issue code. My confidence of 0.90 is above the 0.70 floor, so the case does not escalate. The monetary effect of SGD 5.90 is at or below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this provisional ruling may be executed on issue; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

The driver advocate

kept Taking the trace figure that governs under POL-RD-01 - gps_trace.trace_distance_km of 23.79 against the booked optimal of 18.3 - the excess is 5.49 km, or 30.0% of the optimal. That clears the establishment gates (0.8 km absolute and 20%) but falls short of BOTH materiality gates set by the same clause, 8.0 km absolute and 50%. This trip is therefore an established but NON-material deviation. Materiality is what opens the driver_profile consultation in POL-RD-06, and it is not reached here, so no material-deviation remedy and no uplift is available to the rider.

evidence EV-GPS-02856, EV-TRIP-02856 · clauses POL-RD-01

kept The repeat-deviation pattern test is not met and no profile-based amplification is open to the rider. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 408 - a rate of 0.00, below the 0.05 threshold, and the raw counter is below the 3 required. No pattern is ESTABLISHED, so neither the FULL_REFUND uplift in POL-RD-06(b) nor the driver-conduct referral in POL-RD-06(c) is available, and the rider's remedy stays on the POL-RD-02 arithmetic. Nor is this a case 'otherwise finely balanced' within POL-RD-06: the trace is unimpaired and unopposed, because the rider's detour request was not corroborated by it. POL-GEN-01 confines this claim to the two fields named above; the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is a near-synonym and is not cited, and rating, acceptance_rate, cancellation_rate and active_region are context only.

evidence EV-DPROF-02856 · clauses POL-RD-06, POL-GEN-01

kept The rider's IMM request is genuinely on the file and the driver's account is not a bare assertion: chat message MSG-02856-001 was sent BY THE RIDER at 15:33:19, sixty seconds after the meter started, and carries a platform-resolved waypoint_hint for IMM, so limbs (a) to (c) of POL-RD-04 are met. The driver does not, however, claim exoneration under that clause, and candour requires the reason to be stated: the derived waypoint approach places the nearest fix 3088.34 m from IMM, so the 200 m corroboration test in POL-RD-04 fails, and under POL-RD-14 the instruction is taken as not having caused the measured excess and no distance is excluded. The request therefore neither excuses nor aggravates the deviation - it cannot be used to inflate the excess into a material or aggravated one, and the rider's remedy remains the plain POL-RD-01/POL-RD-02 figure on the trace as measured.

evidence EV-CHAT-02856, EV-GPS-02856 · clauses POL-RD-04, POL-RD-14

kept The refund on this METERED fare is arithmetic and cannot be inflated. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 18.3 + 0.28 x 24.7) x 1.0 surge_multiplier read from the FARE_BREAKDOWN + 0.80 platform fee = 25.241; refund = charged_total 31.13 - 25.241 = 5.889, rounded UP to SGD 5.90. That is above the 0.50 de minimis floor, so it is not a NO_ACTION, and it is 18.9% of charged_total, far below the 90% that would convert it into a FULL_REFUND. The driver's whole monetary exposure on this dispute is therefore SGD 5.90 - not the SGD 8.00 contested and not the SGD 31.13 charged.

evidence EV-FARE-02856, EV-TRIP-02856 · clauses POL-RD-02

kept Nothing is added on top of that figure under POL-RD-09. The fare carries no ERP lines and no airport surcharge: erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp is 0.00, airport_surcharge is 0.00, and this trip runs from Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres to Blk 130 Bukit Batok West Ave 6, so it neither originates nor ends at an airport and no surcharge is properly chargeable. There is accordingly no unmatched gantry and no wrongly applied surcharge, no standalone billing-integrity correction arises, and the POL-RD-02 figure of SGD 5.90 is the entirety of what can move on this case.

This is a rider-filed route-deviation dispute over trip TRP-02856 (Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres to Blk 130 Bukit Batok West Ave 6). Both sides largely agree on the arithmetic, and the arithmetic decides it. A deviation is ESTABLISHED under POL-RD-01. The governing measurement is the GPS trace (gps_trace.trace_distance_km = 23.79 km), not the rounded trip-record copy of 23.8 km. Against the booked optimal of 18.3 km on EV-TRIP-02856, the excess is 5.49 km, or 30.0% of optimal. Both establishment gates pass (over 0.8 km absolute and over 20%). It does NOT reach materiality: 5.49 km is below the 8.0 km absolute gate and 30.0% is below the 50% gate. Because the deviation is not MATERIAL, the POL-RD-06 driver_profile consultation is not triggered and I accept the driver's point that no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) and no driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c) arise. The profile counters confirm this independently: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 408 completed trips in 90 days, far below the 3-flag and 0.05-rate tests. The driver's explanation (counterparty statement: 'The rider asked for IMM, it is in the chat', and the chat itself) does not reduce the excess. The rider's message MSG-02856-001 at 15:33:19 does name IMM with a platform-resolved waypoint_hint, and the driver replied 'ok', but POL-RD-04 corroboration is geographic: the trace must pass within 200 m of the waypoint. The derived waypoint approach places the nearest fix 3,088.34 m from IMM (within_threshold false), so the corroboration test fails. Under POL-RD-14 that means the instruction did not cause the measured excess: POL-RD-04 does not apply, no distance is excluded, and the deviation is measured on the trace as it stands. The driver's bare assertion of the request is an assertion that fails on the artifact it rests on. This is also not the mutually contradictory-evidence escalation in POL-RD-10(7): a request made and a route that did not follow it are consistent, and POL-RD-14 confines that trigger to the partly-corroborated case. There is no escalation on this point. No other exoneration route is open. POL-RD-03 (road closure) needs a traffic advisory: none covers this trip (EV-ADVIS-02856-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, no payload) and no party asserted a traffic cause, so no traffic excuse is even in play. POL-RD-05 does not run: pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at, amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are all null, so the baseline stays the booked 18.3 km. POL-RD-12 does not run: the vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL. POL-RD-11 does not run: the fare model is METERED, not UPFRONT_QUOTE. The refund is therefore the POL-RD-02 arithmetic on a METERED fare. The surge multiplier was read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, where it is 1.0, not assumed absent. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 18.3 + 0.28 x 24.7) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee = 24.441 + 0.80 = 25.241. Refund = charged_total 31.13 - 25.241 = 5.889, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 5.90. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis (so not NO_ACTION) and 18.9% of the charged total, far below the 90% that would convert it to a FULL_REFUND. The outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 5.90, not the SGD 8.00 contested and not the SGD 31.13 charged. Nothing is added under POL-RD-09. The fare carries no ERP lines (erp_gantries empty, tolls_erp 0.00), no airport surcharge (0.00, and the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport), and no waiting-time fee. There is no unmatched gantry and no wrongly applied surcharge, so no billing-integrity finding and no referral arises. Driver compensation under POL-RD-04 does not arise either: the rider was billed 23.8 km against a 23.79 km trace, a shortfall of well under the 1.0 km threshold. The trace is clean for POL-RD-07 purposes: 187 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, an empty gaps array and a max_gap_sec of 0.0, so no limb (a) to (c) is met and no corroboration requirement or POL-RD-10(3) escalation is engaged. Trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown (TRP-02856), timestamps do not conflict, and no charge line lacks a counterpart. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires. My confidence rests on artifacts all at weight_multiplier 1.0 (EV-GPS-02856, EV-TRIP-02856, EV-FARE-02856, EV-CHAT-02856), so the cap is 1.0; the missing advisory (weight 0.0) carries no deciding fact and does not lower it. The one rider claim citing that absent artifact was discarded at the citation stage for not naming its issue code. My confidence of 0.90 is above the 0.70 floor, so the case does not escalate. The monetary effect of SGD 5.90 is at or below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this provisional ruling may be executed on issue; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.
